mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 3.0% (computed from CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1700 thousand units), rising home construction activity supports consumer confidence and durable goods spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances during housing market expansion (HOUST > 1700 thousand units).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (annualized) signals robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales index (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%.
